mapper.insert: INSERT INTO wf_urge_effect (history_id, tenant_id, urge_id) SELECT history.history_id, history.tenant_id, urge.id FROM wf_task_history history JOIN wf_task_urge urge ON urge.tenant_id = history.tenant_id AND urge.task_id = history.task_id WHERE history.history_id = #{history.historyId} AND history.tenant_id = #{history.tenantId} AND urge.create_time <= history.create_time ORDER BY urge.create_time DESC, urge.id DESC LIMIT 1 ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE history_id = wf_urge_effect.history_id
mapper.select: SELECT effect.history_id, urge.create_time AS urge_time, TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, urge.create_time, history.create_time) AS elapsed_seconds FROM wf_urge_effect effect JOIN wf_task_history history ON history.history_id = effect.history_id AND history.tenant_id = effect.tenant_id JOIN wf_task_urge urge ON urge.id = effect.urge_id AND urge.tenant_id = effect.tenant_id AND urge.task_id = history.task_id WHERE effect.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND effect.history_id IN #{historyId}
